data_fields.name: resilience_gain_rooted
data_fields.donor_constant: modified root duration (s) / 10; 0.1 if no duration

data_fields.name: resilience_window_default
data_fields.donor_constant: 30 s when the hit has no duration

best_idea: One shared crowd-control resistance pool per target: each hit adds resistance equal to its own shortened length and lasts 5x that length, so each later root is shorter by a fixed share of what is left, with no hard rule.
decision_why: Keep the shared pool, the gain-from-shortened-duration rule and the 5x window; add a proposed 0.9 cap on the summed resistance so a root never reaches zero, because Proof 3 needs a visible floor rather than an immunity wall.
acceptance: Server test: five 3-second roots inside 15 s on one target last 3.0, 2.1, 1.47, 1.03 and 0.72 s; with the 0.9 cap no 3-second root is shorter than 0.3 s; the HUD shows a resilience pip with the summed value.
